mission: Native remote DeepSeek Harness control: connect computer, choose workspace/session, send task, observe tools, approve or deny, stop, recover.
releaseScope: Implementation and bounded hosted verification; store submission deferred.
firstServer: User-selected HTTPS origin implementing the pinned self-hosted v1 REST and relay protocol; no default funded service.

nativeCryptoSPI.swift: @MainActor public protocol RemoteHarnessCryptoBackend: AnyObject { var isAvailable: Bool { get }; func publicKey(privateSeed: Data) throws -> Data; func initiator(privateSeed: Data, peerPublicKey: Data, info: RemoteHarnessSecureConnectionInfo) throws -> any RemoteHarnessSecureNoise }; RemoteHarnessCryptoBackends.native() -> any RemoteHarnessCryptoBackend
nativeCryptoSPI.kotlin: interface RemoteHarnessCryptoBackend { val isAvailable: Boolean; fun publicKey(privateSeed: ByteArray): ByteArray; fun initiator(privateSeed: ByteArray, peerPublicKey: ByteArray, info: RemoteHarnessSecureConnectionInfo): RemoteHarnessSecureNoise }; RemoteHarnessCryptoBackends.native(): RemoteHarnessCryptoBackend
nativeCryptoSPI.implementation: Generated UniFFI bindings and matching locked Rust library. Absent SDK returns an explicit unavailable backend; never substitute fake cryptography in production.
nativeCryptoSPI.privateSeed: Exactly 32 OS-random bytes generated and retained by native secure storage. Explicit transient export to the maintained FFI only; no debug or persistence outside secure credential storage.

journey: Computer destination is available before a local model download.
Enter server origin, then account email/password through secure native UI.
Durably reserve device identity before registration; persist returned tokens before use.
List authorized Hosts, verify descriptor role/ID/membership and full public-key pin.
Make first trust explicit; never silently replace a changed pin.
Authenticate the relay socket, negotiate relay limits, request Host connection and obtain the Noise connection ID.
Finish Noise before business dispatch; discover workspaces without fabricating a saved profile.
Select actual workspace, create a valid profile, select or create session, then obtain authoritative history and streams.
Send a task once after durable command preparation; display streaming text, reasoning and tool activity.
Approval decisions require the negotiated Host extension and exact device/workspace/session/run/action/expiry binding.
Stop requested stays distinct from authoritative stopped; uncertain outcomes are retained and never automatically replayed.
Recover saved session/history after relaunch or reconnect, preserving drafts and the execution destination.

credentials.scope: Canonical relay origin, client device ID and client role; Host provider credentials stay on the computer.
credentials.accountPassword: Entry-only, never saved by default, no autofill/state restoration/diagnostics or clipboard export.
credentials.accountToken: Temporary setup use; cookies are disabled and it is discarded after device registration.
credentials.deviceTokens: Native Keychain or Keystore-backed encrypted record, excluded from backup/transfer.
credentials.refresh: One serialized durable attempt reservation before dispatch. Install rotated pair atomically. A lost response or uncertain commit requires reauthorization; never replay a single-use refresh token.
credentials.keyRecovery: Never silently regenerate identity or overwrite a failed credential/history read.

transport.authentication: Device token in the bounded hello body over TLS; never URL/query parameters.
transport.frameBounds: Existing native Control JSON limits, clamped to the negotiated server limits.
transport.sendQueue: Bound the asynchronous socket handoff separately from the secure-link plaintext queue; at most 8 MiB and 256 messages, finite send deadline.
transport.ownership: Swift MainActor; Kotlin all coordinator/link interactions on the enforced owner thread. Every async callback retains its original generation.
transport.reconnect: User-controlled bounded recovery, no mutation replay, no automatic identity reset.

nativeUI.apple: SwiftUI system navigation/forms/list/toolbars, preserving Mac/iPhone/iPad conventions.
nativeUI.android: Existing Compose Material navigation and state patterns.
nativeUI.entry: Existing onboarding and ready shell, alongside Local and direct DeepSeek.
nativeUI.status: Server, computer, workspace, session, model, connection and remote execution location stay visible.
nativeUI.timeline: Native text/tool/approval presentation; no web shell or second local agent loop.
nativeUI.errors: Actionable fixed messages; never raw server diagnostics, credential values or key prefixes.
nativeUI.privacy: Local conversations are never read or uploaded by the remote destination.

verification.allowedNow: Host fixtures, real generated-binding crypto integration, hosted SDK/app compilation. No local native build, model download, simulator or physical-device run.
verification.proofBoundaries: Synthetic server and in-memory provider evidence are labelled. Native rendering, signed storage and a live Host remain distinct checks.
verification.coreAcceptance: A single native controller completes setup through a streaming session and recovery using the same injected bounded fixture server; the production transports and SDKs compile with the actual app.
verification.publication: Fresh independent review, staged secret scans and relevant integrated checks before authorized source merge.

hostCompanion.runID: turn:<integer> from authoritative session/follow turn/start data.turn or snapshot assistantStream.activeAttempt.turn; invalidated on turn/end
hostCompanion.actionDigest: SHA256 lowercase hex of complete recursively sorted JSON request
hostCompanion.trust: Explicit full public identity pins on both devices; Host public policy is checked before auto-pin, per message and every two seconds
hostCompanion.legacyApproval: $events/result remains blocked remotely; missing authoritative scope requires the computer
limitations: No durable Host mutation deduplication yet
Pending approval recovery across Host restart may require computer
No agent spending cap or terminal sandbox
